interpretation: The sequence report is hash-pinned and validated as repeated R580 stock V100 ioctl request metadata. All request names in that trace are included in the compiled exact-header probe; UVM_EVENT_CTRL and UVM_PAGEABLE_MEM_ACCESS_ON_GPU are separately probed requests not seen in the retained trace. Matching command numbers and host-compiled field layouts are necessary UAPI evidence, not proof that proprietary userspace sends identical payload values or that either kernel accepts the other branch's runtime calls. R580 and R595 keep the same request numbers for the probed commands, but UVM_EVENT_CTRL, UVM_FREE, and UVM_UNREGISTER_CHANNEL have branch-specific payload layouts.
